error.message: Column SCDS5: a second liquid would form on stage 7 (stage 7 at 343.8 K: its liquid Ethanol 0.2413, Water 0.4675, Ethyl acetate 0.2746, Acetic acid 0.01661 splits off a liquid Ethanol 0.09742, Water 0.8707, Ethyl acetate 0.02539, Acetic acid 0.006486). With phases "VL" the column holds one liquid on each stage, so it does not return this answer. Turn on "look for two liquids on the stages" (phases "VLL", activity models only), or change the feed or the specifications, or separate the liquids first (a decanter: the flash drum).
